name: Shenhe
notes: A Cryo ATK buffer. Spring Spirit Summoning's Quill adds DMG equal to a share of her ATK (45.7% at level 1) and the Burst lowers Cryo RES, so everything scales with ATK; both sources put the Skill first and the Burst second. The sources agree on ATK% for the Sands, Goblet and Circlet (ER on the Sands as an option, Cryo DMG or CRIT on the Goblet or Circlet for the Burst support build; CRIT Rate if she holds a Favonius weapon) and on Calamity Queller first, with Favonius Lance and Engulfing Lightning behind it. The sets differ by build: 4pc Noblesse Oblige is KQM's usual best and Game8's for the Cryo Burst support build; Game8's pure ATK support build prefers Gladiator's Finale or Shimenawa's Reminiscence, and KQM adds Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City and Blizzard Strayer. Neither source gives stat goals. The only goal is ER, KQM's 180-200% for double Cryo without the Favonius Lance (165-175% with a Lance proc; 145-175% in triple Cryo).
